triggers.confirmation_guard:
CREATE TRIGGER confirmation_guard BEFORE INSERT ON doctor_confirmations BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM users u JOIN care_relationships r ON r.doctor_id=u.id
        JOIN proposals p ON p.patient_id=r.patient_id
        WHERE u.id=new.doctor_id AND u.role='doctor' AND u.disabled=0
        AND r.ends_at IS NULL AND p.id=new.proposal_id
        AND p.version=new.proposal_version AND p.status!='withdrawn'
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'confirmation requires current leading doctor and proposal version') END;
END

triggers.relationship_check_guard:
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_check_guard BEFORE INSERT ON relationship_checks BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_relationships r JOIN patients p ON p.id=r.patient_id
        JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id
        WHERE r.id=new.relationship_id AND r.ends_at IS NULL
        AND p.user_id=new.patient_user_id AND u.disabled=0
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'current patient relationship required') END;
END
triggers.clinical_entry_author:
CREATE TRIGGER clinical_entry_author BEFORE INSERT ON clinical_entries BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id=new.actor_id AND u.disabled=0 AND (
            (new.kind='self_report' AND u.role='patient' AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM patients p WHERE p.id=new.patient_id AND p.user_id=u.id))
            OR (new.kind='visit' AND u.role='doctor' AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM care_relationships r WHERE r.patient_id=new.patient_id
                AND r.doctor_id=u.id AND r.ends_at IS NULL AND r.starts_at<=new.recorded_at))
        )
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'entry requires authorized author') END;
END

triggers.assessment_request_author:
CREATE TRIGGER assessment_request_author BEFORE INSERT ON assessment_requests BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_relationships r JOIN users u ON u.id=r.doctor_id
        JOIN patients p ON p.id=r.patient_id WHERE r.id=new.relationship_id
        AND r.patient_id=new.patient_id AND r.doctor_id=new.requested_by
        AND r.ends_at IS NULL AND r.starts_at<=new.requested_at
        AND u.role='doctor' AND u.disabled=0 AND p.synthetic=1
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'assessment requires leading doctor') END;
END
triggers.assessment_result_author:
CREATE TRIGGER assessment_result_author BEFORE INSERT ON assessment_results BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM assessment_requests q JOIN care_relationships r ON r.id=q.relationship_id
        JOIN patients p ON p.id=q.patient_id JOIN users u ON u.id=new.actor_id
        JOIN users d ON d.id=r.doctor_id JOIN assessments a ON a.id=new.assessment_id
        WHERE q.id=new.request_id AND r.ends_at IS NULL AND r.starts_at<=new.recorded_at
        AND q.expires_at>new.recorded_at AND u.disabled=0 AND d.disabled=0
        AND p.synthetic=1 AND a.patient_id=q.patient_id AND a.scale_version_id=q.form_version_id
        AND a.assigned_by=q.requested_by AND a.score IS NULL
        AND ((u.role='patient' AND p.user_id=u.id) OR (u.role='doctor' AND r.doctor_id=u.id))
        AND ((a.completeness='complete' AND new.scores_json IS NOT NULL)
          OR (a.completeness='incomplete' AND new.scores_json IS NULL))
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'assessment requires authorized response') END;
END

triggers.released_definition_no_rewrite:
CREATE TRIGGER released_definition_no_rewrite BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_versions
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assessment_form_releases WHERE form_version_id=old.id)
AND (new.id IS NOT old.id OR new.kind IS NOT old.kind OR new.code IS NOT old.code
 OR new.version IS NOT old.version OR new.source_version_id IS NOT old.source_version_id
 OR new.definition_json IS NOT old.definition_json OR new.min_age IS NOT old.min_age
 OR new.max_age IS NOT old.max_age OR new.age_basis IS NOT old.age_basis)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'released form requires new version'); END
triggers.released_source_no_rewrite:
CREATE TRIGGER released_source_no_rewrite BEFORE UPDATE ON source_versions
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_versions c JOIN assessment_form_releases r ON r.form_version_id=c.id WHERE c.source_version_id=old.id)
AND (new.id IS NOT old.id OR new.url IS NOT old.url OR new.sha256 IS NOT old.sha256 OR new.version IS NOT old.version
 OR new.population_json IS NOT old.population_json)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'released source requires new version'); END

triggers.clinical_context_author:
CREATE TRIGGER clinical_context_author BEFORE INSERT ON clinical_contexts BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM users u JOIN care_relationships r ON r.doctor_id=u.id JOIN patients p ON p.id=r.patient_id
        WHERE u.id=new.actor_id AND u.role='doctor' AND u.disabled=0 AND p.synthetic=1
        AND p.id=new.patient_id AND r.id=new.relationship_id AND r.ends_at IS NULL AND r.starts_at<=new.recorded_at
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'context requires authorized synthetic doctor') END;
END
triggers.clinical_rule_evaluation_patient:
CREATE TRIGGER clinical_rule_evaluation_patient BEFORE INSERT ON clinical_rule_evaluations BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinical_entries e WHERE e.id=new.entry_id
        AND e.patient_id=new.patient_id AND e.kind='self_report') OR (new.context_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinical_contexts c WHERE c.id=new.context_id AND c.patient_id=new.patient_id))
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'evaluation source mismatch') END;
END
triggers.critical_event_source:
CREATE TRIGGER critical_event_source BEFORE INSERT ON critical_events BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinical_rule_evaluations e WHERE e.id=new.evaluation_id
        AND e.patient_id=new.patient_id AND e.rule_version=new.rule_version AND e.result='triggered')
        OR (new.relationship_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM care_relationships r
        WHERE r.id=new.relationship_id AND r.patient_id=new.patient_id AND r.doctor_id=new.recipient_id))
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'critical event source mismatch') END;
END

triggers.first_visit_author:
CREATE TRIGGER first_visit_author BEFORE INSERT ON first_visit_versions BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_relationships r JOIN users u ON u.id=r.doctor_id
        JOIN patients p ON p.id=r.patient_id
        WHERE r.id=new.relationship_id AND r.patient_id=new.patient_id
        AND u.id=new.actor_id AND u.role='doctor' AND u.disabled=0
        AND r.ends_at IS NULL AND r.starts_at<=new.recorded_at AND p.synthetic=1
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'first visit requires authorized physician') END;
    SELECT CASE WHEN new.revision != COALESCE((SELECT max(revision)+1 FROM first_visit_versions WHERE visit_id=new.visit_id),1)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM first_visit_versions WHERE visit_id=new.visit_id
            AND (patient_id!=new.patient_id OR state='completed'))
        THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid first visit revision') END;
END

triggers.first_visit_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER first_visit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON first_visit_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only first visit'); END
triggers.report_draft_insert_owner:
CREATE TRIGGER report_draft_insert_owner BEFORE INSERT ON self_report_drafts BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM patients p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id
        WHERE p.id=new.patient_id AND u.id=new.owner_id AND u.role='patient'
        AND u.disabled=0 AND p.synthetic=1
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'private draft requires owner') END;
END
triggers.report_draft_update_owner:
CREATE TRIGGER report_draft_update_owner BEFORE UPDATE ON self_report_drafts BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN new.owner_id!=old.owner_id OR new.patient_id!=old.patient_id
        OR new.revision!=old.revision+1 OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM patients p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id
            WHERE p.id=new.patient_id AND u.id=new.owner_id AND u.role='patient'
            AND u.disabled=0 AND p.synthetic=1
        ) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'invalid private draft update') END;
END
